entry.title: New: RES23-298 (Honolulu) — FILE
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT OF TRAVEL, GROUND TRANSPORTATION, AND LODGING WITH AN ESTIMATED VALUE OF $1,015.68 TO THE CITY FROM HAWAII P-20 PARTNERSHIPS FOR EDUCATION FOR TWO STAFF FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF COMMUNITY SERVICES TO ATTEND THE EARLY CHILDHOOD CONFERENCE 2023 IN KAILUA-KONA, HAWAII, DECEMBER 1-2, 2023.

Latest action: Filed pursuant to ROH SEC 1-2.5 which sets a one-year filing period on pending resolutions.
